correctness.rationale: The maximal worlds of each full nonempty powerset frame under reverse inclusion are exactly the singletons. Upward lifting forces images of singleton worlds to be singletons, defining a unique underlying function. Monotonicity provides the forward inclusion at each world, and lifting each target singleton back into a nonempty source subset proves equality with the direct image. Conversely, the explicit preimage intersection supplies the required lift for every nonempty target successor, even on infinite underlying sets and without a choice principle. Composition, generated-image factorization, and the standard counts of set maps and surjections are then exact. Direct brute-force code checked all 826,113 world maps for underlying set sizes one through three, identifying 56 p-morphisms, exactly those predicted. The finite check corroborates the written universal proof and does not replace it.

originality.rationale: The complete natural bijection \(\operatorname{Hom}(\mathsf P_X,\mathsf P_Y)\cong Y^X\) for every pair of nonempty sets and the induced classification of surjective morphisms are not stated by the inspected source theorems. Vio already treats automorphisms and selected onto maps, and Ciardelli gives the endpoint structure; these are acknowledged concrete prior ingredients. This is a conditional self-review, not a uniqueness certificate. The possibility of an older categorical or semilattice equivalent remains a material risk.
residual_risks: The complete direct-image characterization may exist in older semilattice/category-theoretic or bounded-morphism literature under terminology not used by these sources.
The exact classification is elementary once one has recognized that maximal successor worlds are singletons; some experts may regard it as folklore rather than novel.
The accessed sources were inspected at directly relevant portions and via targeted text searching; not every cited historical reference was available and independently reviewed.

value.rationale: The classical full-subset Kripke frames are intrinsically motivated by Medvedev logic. A complete full/faithful categorical description is a natural exact classification of all frame morphisms (including infinite and nononto cases), not an arbitrary restricted numerical slice. It makes the frame-reduction mechanism precise: images are generated subframes, onto maps correspond precisely to surjections, and all finite hom-set sizes follow simultaneously. The result clarifies which classical maps preserve Kripke-frame truth under p-morphic images; known automorphism and example maps are identified as special cases, not claimed as new.
